howItWorks.title: How to convert PDF to Excel
steps: Upload the PDF file you want to convert.
Click Convert to extract its content into a spreadsheet.

items.q: Does this work well for any PDF?
items.a: It works best on PDFs that already contain clear, simple tables. Text is extracted with its layout spacing and split into columns automatically — a scanned image, a PDF with no real table structure, or a complex multi-column layout will convert with limited accuracy. This isn't equivalent to a commercial table-extraction tool.

items.q: Is converting PDF to Excel free?
items.a: Yes, converting PDF to Excel is free within the daily usage limits shown above.

items.q: Will my file be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.
